raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Change Summary

- **What changed?** VLDA project page updates on the `gh-pages` site:
  - `projects/vlda.html`: replaced the disabled "Paper · arXiv soon"
    placeholder in the hero with a live arXiv paper button
    (https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25874); added a `url` line to the citation
    BibTeX; updated the citation note to link the arXiv preprint.
  - `assets/js/vlda.js`: updated the matching Chinese i18n strings
    (`hero.paper`, `c.note`) so the paper link renders correctly in both
    languages.
- **Which issue or requirement does this address?** The paper is now public
  on arXiv; the project page needed the live paper link instead of the
  "coming soon" placeholder.
- **Which modules are affected?** `projects/vlda.html` and
  `assets/js/vlda.js` only. Static site content, no source code.

## Validation

- [x] I ran the relevant local checks. (`git diff` confirms only the
      intended content changes — no whitespace/formatting noise; i18n
      English/Chinese pairs updated consistently.)
- [ ] I added or updated tests where appropriate. (N/A — static site page.)
- [x] I checked compatibility with existing APIs and configurations.
      (Uses the existing `data-t` i18n mechanism and `lf-btn` /
      `lf-inline-link` styles; no behavior changes.)

## CI, GPU, and Image Impact

- [ ] This change affects dependencies, Dockerfiles, patches, or runtime environments.
- [ ] GPU validation is required. Suggested suite: `llm_vlm` / `embodied`.
- [ ] A local candidate image should be built during GPU validation.
- [x] No GPU or image validation is required.

## Reviewer Notes

- Please confirm the arXiv ID (`2610.25874`) before merge.
- This targets the `gh-pages` site branch. Pushing to the fork
  (`zls030726/LoongForge-1`) only updates the fork's pages; the official
  `baidu-baige.github.io` site updates only when merged into upstream
  `gh-pages`.
- Recommend a quick visual check of the hero paper button and the citation
  link in both EN and ZH before publishing.
